item.tib: gnad them srog gi spu gri
item.coloph: rig 'dzin kun gyi thugs kyi bcud/ log lta sgrol byed drag dmigs 'di/ skal ldan skyes bu gcig la gtad/ gsang sbas thabs la mkhas par gyis/ mang du ma spel rgyal khams phung / de bas cig rgyud sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ mkha' 'gro mas rnal 'byor mi shig rdo rje rtsal la gtad do//
